meta.note: Keys are the English source strings. Missing keys fall back to English.

ui.Click the button at the bottom or press: Click the button at the bottom or press your hotkey to show or hide it.
ui.Waiting for a game. Start one and click: Waiting for a game. Start one and click into it.
ui.Pick what the overlay shows. Changes app: Pick what the overlay shows. Changes apply right away.
Style, size and position of the overlay.
ui.Vertical is a compact panel. Horizontal: Vertical is a compact panel. Horizontal and Bar fit everything on one line.
ui.Click a spot on the screen, or hold Ctrl: Click a spot on the screen, or hold Ctrl over the overlay and drag it anywhere. It snaps to the screen edges.
Which monitor the overlay lives on.
ui.Green, yellow and red for frame rate, te: Green, yellow and red for frame rate, temperatures and memory.
FPS, GPU, CPU and RAM captions.
ui.Hide when no game is running: Hide when no game is running
ui.The overlay appears only while the app i: The overlay appears only while the app in front is drawing frames.
ui.OBS, Discord streams and screenshots wil: OBS, Discord streams and screenshots will not show the overlay. You still see it.
ui.Where the numbers come from, and how oft: Where the numbers come from, and how often they update.
ui.Automatic picks the card with the most v: Automatic picks the card with the most video memory.
The temperature the CPU itself reports. Best for spotting overheating.
ui.Includes a fan-control offset, so it rea: Includes a fan-control offset, so it reads higher than the real temperature.
ui.Package is the CPU's own reading. Averag: Package is the CPU's own reading. Average of all cores is lower and steadier.
ui.No motherboard fans were found. They nee: No motherboard fans were found. They need the PawnIO driver.
ui.CPU temperature, CPU power and motherboa: CPU temperature, CPU power and motherboard fans are read through this small open-source driver.
ui.Install it to see CPU temperature and po: Install it to see CPU temperature and power. No restart needed in most cases.
A newer version comes with this app.
ui.If the CPU temperature stays empty, rest: If the CPU temperature stays empty, restart Windows once.
ui.30 is smooth for numbers. Raise it for a: 30 is smooth for numbers. Raise it for a smoother frame time graph.
ui.Longer windows are steadier; shorter one: Longer windows are steadier; shorter ones react faster.
ui.They work everywhere, even while a game: They work everywhere, even while a game has focus.
ui.Click a key, then press the new combinat: Click a key, then press the new combination. Esc cancels, Backspace removes it.
ui.Starts quietly in the tray when you sign: Starts quietly in the tray when you sign in. No admin prompt.
ui.Downloads new versions from GitHub, chec: Downloads new versions from GitHub, checks them and installs them when no game is running.
ui.A lightweight frame rate and hardware ov: A lightweight frame rate and hardware overlay for Windows games.
ui.It installs by itself when no game is ru: It installs by itself when no game is running.
ui.Free software under the GNU General Publ: Free software under the GNU General Public License v3. See LICENSE.txt and NOTICE.md next to the app.
ui.Built with Dear ImGui (MIT), LibreHardwa: Built with Dear ImGui (MIT), LibreHardwareMonitor (MPL 2.0), RTLScript and the PawnIO driver.
ui.The overlay is already running. Start a: The overlay is already running. Start a game and click into it to see its frame rate.
ui.Press Insert to show or hide it. You can: Press Insert to show or hide it. You can change this under Hotkeys.
ui.Hold Ctrl over the overlay to drag it, o: Hold Ctrl over the overlay to drag it, or Ctrl + right-click for its menu.
ui.Closing this window keeps the overlay ru: Closing this window keeps the overlay running in the tray.
ui.For CPU temperature, install the PawnIO: For CPU temperature, install the PawnIO driver under Sensors.
ui.Average frames per second of the game in: Average frames per second of the game in front.
Average time per frame in milliseconds.
Average FPS of the slowest 1% of frames. Shows stutter that the average hides.
ui.Average FPS of the slowest 0.1% of frame: Average FPS of the slowest 0.1% of frames. Catches rare hitches.
ui.Live graph of recent frame times. Spikes: Live graph of recent frame times. Spikes are stutters.
ui.DirectX 12, DirectX 11, Vulkan, OpenGL o: DirectX 12, DirectX 11, Vulkan, OpenGL or DirectX 9.
ui.Hottest point on the GPU die. Uses a slo: Hottest point on the GPU die. Uses a slower sensor path.
ui.Effective clock, the same number Task Ma: Effective clock, the same number Task Manager shows.
ui.Needs the PawnIO driver and a supported: Needs the PawnIO driver and a supported motherboard.
Name of the program being measured.
